ADVERT I SEMENT
Applications in Standard Form are hereby invited from eligible candidates who are citizens
of India for Recruitment to the following posts at fixed pay of Rs.34,250/- per month in the UP-
Graded RMSA Sec. Schools on contract basis for the period of l(one) year and to be renewed
annually.
Age limit: 32 years and 5 years relaxation for ST/SC.
SI. No. Name of post Vacant post Qualification
I Asst. Teacher-Mathematics Graduate/Preferably Post Graduate in
I Mathematics with B.Ed.
Candidate(s) with certified diploma in Computer or knowledge on usage of ICT in the teaching
learning process, active involvement in Sports, Co-curricular activities, Art/Craft/Culture etc. besides the
above prescribed qualification will be an added advantage.
Interested candidates are to submit the application on or before 15thOctober 2026to the office of
the undersigned. Applicants are requested to mention the phone number and e-mail address in the
application form.
Photocopies of relevant documents/certificate testimonials for record and original documents for
verification should be produced during the interview. No TA/DA will be paid.
The Date of interview for the above posts will be notified later.
